recognize_zh: 這是 WHO 2016 混合表型急性白血病（MPAL）的譜系指定準則表格：骨髓系看 MPO 或單核球分化、T 系看細胞質 CD3、B 系看強 CD19 加上 CD79a、cCD22、CD10 其一；表中螢光標示 MPO、強 CD19 與 CD79a，代表本病例屬 B/骨髓系。
features: Table summarizing WHO 2016 criteria for assigning more than one lineage to a single blast population
Myeloid lineage: MPO (flow, IHC, or cytochemistry) or monocytic differentiation (at least 2 of NSE, CD11c, CD14, CD64, lysozyme)
T-cell lineage: cytoplasmic CD3 by flow (CD3 epsilon) or surface CD3; polyclonal IHC CD3 may detect non-specific zeta chain
B-cell lineage: strong CD19 with at least 1 strong of CD79a, cCD22, CD10; or weak CD19 with at least 2 of these
Highlighted items (MPO, strong CD19, CD79a) indicate the markers satisfied in the index B/myeloid case
describe_en: This figure is a reference table, not a morphologic image, listing the WHO 2016 immunophenotypic requirements for assigning myeloid, T-cell, and B-cell lineage to a blast population. Myeloid lineage requires MPO or evidence of monocytic differentiation; T-cell lineage requires cytoplasmic or surface CD3; B-cell lineage requires strong CD19 with one additional strong B-cell marker, or weak CD19 with two. The highlighted markers (MPO, strong CD19, and CD79a) show that the blasts in the reference case fulfill both myeloid and B-cell criteria. These findings support a diagnosis of mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid, NOS, after exclusion of defining genetic abnormalities such as BCR::ABL1 and KMT2A rearrangement.
